title: denidin-morning config schema
description: Canonical, runtime-loaded schema for apps/morning-mcp-app/config/config.json. FLAT shape: the three required credential keys are top-level (matching config.example.json / config.test.json and the existing sandbox integration tests, which read them flat). All runtime config comes from this file per CONSTITUTION §I (no environment variables). Mirrored for documentation at specs/in-definition/005-mcp-morning-green-receipt/artifacts/config.schema.json — keep both in sync; this copy is what config.py actually loads at runtime (self-contained for Docker, which does not copy the specs/ tree).

api_key_id.description: Morning API key id, used in the /account/token JWT exchange.

api_key_secret.description: Morning API key secret, used in the /account/token JWT exchange.

api_url.description: Base URL for the Morning REST API. Sandbox: https://sandbox.d.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1/ ; Production: https://api.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1/

file_upload_url.description: Optional: Morning file-upload gateway base URL (separate domain). Reserved for the future receipt-parsing feature (017); not used by the 8 invoice tools.

token_ttl_seconds.description: Assumed JWT lifetime; MorningAuth caches the token for this long.

refresh_before_seconds.description: Refresh the token when it is within this many seconds of expiry.

rate_limit_per_second.description: Client-side rate limit to stay under Morning's ~3 req/s (429) ceiling.

openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key used only by tests/expensive/test_openai_invokes_mcp_e2e.py (Phase 5, T021) to drive this server as a remote MCP tool via the real OpenAI Responses API. Not read by the server itself. Never commit a real value - keep it in config/config.json only.

host.description: Bind address. The default (127.0.0.1, loopback-only) is correct and safest for plain local dev, but is NOT reachable through Docker's port mapping (-p) or an ngrok tunnel targeting the container - a process bound only to the container's own loopback cannot be reached from outside its network namespace (confirmed live: curl from the host got a connection failure until this was changed). Docker/container deployments MUST set this to '0.0.0.0' in the mounted config.json.

auth_token.description: Optional shared bearer-token secret. If set, the MCP server rejects any request without a matching 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header (401) - see server.py's BearerTokenMiddleware. If unset (default), no auth is enforced - appropriate for pure local/dev use (this server has one expected main consumer, denidin-app, plus ad hoc manual tests; set this once the server is exposed via a tunnel/public URL). Never commit a real value - keep it in config/config.json only.

ngrok_authtoken.description: Optional ngrok account authtoken. If set (along with ngrok_domain), run_morning_mcp.sh starts a persistent ngrok tunnel exposing this server publicly (used by tests/expensive - the OpenAI remote-MCP E2E test - which needs a URL OpenAI can reach). If unset, no tunnel is started; the server just runs locally as before. Never commit a real value.

ngrok_domain.description: Optional ngrok reserved/static domain (requires a paid ngrok plan) to give the tunnel a stable hostname across restarts, e.g. 'your-app.ngrok-free.app' or a custom reserved domain. Only used if ngrok_authtoken is also set.

enable_mcp_server.description: Gate for starting the FastMCP server. When false, the server entrypoint does not start; the existing client library and its integration tests are unaffected.
